# Current immutable-profile positive lineage corpus

The uncompressed `current-profile.json.gz` SHA-256 is `00b456faa8eac95124fbe6fde9ec5d70604fd503d7e486385662e6b1494f26ee`.
Its descriptor, signed genesis, raw transactions, BEEF, headers and original
buyer preparations/terms/purchases are unchanged positive records selected from
BRC PR295 commit `1b9a75e497b5856675af1ce01fd86843c37d07f9`,
`overlays/media/0192-0199/wire-vectors.json.gz`; that upstream uncompressed
archive digest is `a8f130d7b0fd89fb301e9327ecef2eb5f39374efb6ade9d7fc0b88c11c63e2eb`.
Only the corpus envelope/selection differs. The disclosed seller/funding toy
actor identities match the companion SDK witness corpus. No negative or
transaction-malleability variant is generated here.

`revenue-profile.fixture.ts` extends the supplied easy-work header ancestry to
height101 for the fixture coinbase maturity rule. This is synthetic verification
context, never mainnet evidence, a live spend, funded purchase or miner acceptance.
Additional ordinary split/payout/retirement transactions use complete existing
sources and protected child-signing APIs with disclosed offline toy actors. Script
execution of unsigned retirement alone does not establish height finality or
selected-chain inclusion. Native custody, alias recovery, wallet containment,
all adapter integrations and full qualification remain independent requirements.
